title: Modularize presubmit instrumentation and add dependency-coordinator shim
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: presubmit instrumentation and lightweight dependency coordination logic were scattered across .github workflows, tools/ci, and a few service adapters in infra/. That made it hard to iterate on metrics, introduce targeted sampling, or coordinate cross-repo dependency updates without touching many pipelines. This PR extracts presubmit instrumentation helpers into tools/ci/presubmit-instrumentation, introduces a small dependency-coordinator shim to centralize dep update sequencing for monorepo-adjacent repos, and wires a guarded rollout so we can enable the coordinator incrementally. Changes: 1) New package tools/ci/presubmit-instrumentation with a clear public surface: emitPresubmitEvent(), sampleBuildTrace(), and shardHintForPath(). These helpers encapsulate metric tags (repo, pr_number, file_change_category) and reduce workflow YAML noise. 2) Introduced tools/ci/dep-coordinator/ which implements a lightweight CLI that takes a dep-manifest and computes an ordered update plan across subprojects, emitting a small plan artifact consumed by a new workflow step. The coordinator is intentionally hermetic and uses the same lockfile parsing code as the existing dep tooling. 3) Reworked .github/workflows/presubmit.yml to call the new emitPresubmitEvent wrapper, use shardHintForPath() for test slicing, and to accept an optional plan artifact uploaded by the coordinator. 4) Added feature flag gating (CI_FEATURE_FLAGS) and a rollout document in docs/ci/rollouts/presubmit-dep-coordinator.md. 5) Minor cleanup: removed duplicated metric tag logic from build/ci-hooks.sh and consolidated rate-limited sampling in one place. Compatibility and safety: the coordinator is opt-in. Default behavior remains unchanged unless the workflow picks up a plan artifact (we use conditional: if: steps.coordinator.outputs.plan_present == 'true'). The presubmit-instrumentation package is safe: fallbacks are provided when environment variables are missing so older runners continue to function. Testing performed: - Local unit tests for the new modules: run ./tools/ci/presubmit-instrumentation/test.sh (added). - Integration test harness: small-slice smoke against the presubmit workflow using the dry-run flag for the coordinator. - Dogfood: staged rollout on a single non-blocking repo (redwood-examples) for two weeks, telemetry validated (see CI checks). Checklist: - [x] Extract instrumentation helpers and update workflows - [x] Add dep-coordinator CLI and tests - [x] Add rollout doc + feature flag - [x] Run dogfood and verify telemetry - [x] Address reviewer feedback and deterministic output format Rollout plan: start feature-flag off on main, enable for redwood-examples and redwood-sdk-python for one week, then enable for all non-critical repos; enable for core redwood repo after two weeks and a rollback window. Related: ENG-2143 (presubmit-sampling), ENG-2198 (dep-update-orchestration).

review_comments: Diego Morales: Nice decomposition. A couple of nits: can shardHintForPath return a stable hash instead of path-based buckets? We want reproducible shards across runs.
Asha Patel (author): Good point — updated shardHintForPath to include an optional SEED env var and added deterministic hashing in index.sh. See commit 6f3a2d4.
Rachel Kim: The CLI looks great but can we avoid parsing vendor lockfile quirks inline? Suggest reuse of the dep-utils parser used by tools/dep/.
Asha Patel (author): Reused dep-utils parsing via wrapper to avoid duplication; moved corner-case tests to fixtures. Updated manifest_parser.go accordingly.
Omar Singh: CI feature flag semantics look fine. Add a brief note in docs about how to force-enable during incident troubleshooting.
Asha Patel (author): Added a troubleshooting subsection and a CI_FORCE_PLAN env var in the coordinator README.
release_notes: Add presubmit instrumentation package and opt-in dependency coordinator CLI. Feature gated behind CI_FEATURE_FLAGS. No behavior change unless enabled.
